subject.title: [Feature]: Unify Claude Code / Codex session catalogs into native session UX

question: Should generic catalog adoption always create a distinct native session with source provenance, and which optional continue/archive capabilities belong in the first public API?
rationale: Current source proves the duplicated architecture, but only maintainer intent can choose the permanent public identity and lifecycle semantics across unlike provider contracts.

options.title: Capability-based adoption
options.body: Expose generic list/read plus optional continue/archive capabilities, with adoption returning a distinct native session while preserving the external source.

options.title: Read-only first
options.body: Unify listing and transcript projection now, then design adoption and archive in a separate follow-up.

options.title: Provider-selected continuation
options.body: Expose one generic continue action while allowing each provider to resume or fork according to its own behavior.

recommendation.title: Capability-based adoption
recommendation.body: Expose generic list/read plus optional continue/archive capabilities, with adoption returning a distinct native session while preserving the external source.

likelyOwner.reason: This person authored both current implementations and is assigned to the issue proposing their permanent public contract.
